{{Quote|You might try talking to my colleague Calathi, in there.|[[Unidentified bartender (Crimson Redrum)|Crimson Redrum bartender]] to [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]|<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>}}
'''Calathi''' was the name of the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] working in the [[Green Dystopia]], one of the barrooms of [[Quarek'k]], which was a large bar complex located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] shortly after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] was directed to Calathi by the [[Crimson Redrum]]'s [[Unidentified bartender (Crimson Redrum)|bartender]] while looking for information regarding the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]].<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows" />
